paragraph_functions.role: 【深】奥巴马医改的核心逻辑：让医保与工作解绑
paragraph_functions.core_point: 平价医疗法案的核心立意之一，就是打破过去'唯有全职工作才配享有医疗保险'的资本主义桎梏，允许民众自由选择工时。
paragraph_functions.cohesive_devices: 揭示立法初衷与社会福利机制（purpose was to allow people to get insurance outside of employment）。

paragraph_functions.role: 【合】终结'工位锁定'恶疾：赋能劳动者拥抱生活与创业自由
paragraph_functions.core_point: 超过1200万人通过医改获得独立医疗保障，终于不必为了医保在不喜欢的全职岗位上忍气吞声，有力促成了自愿兼职与人生自由的绽放。
paragraph_functions.cohesive_devices: 以医保制度红利赋能劳动者自主作结（allowed 12 million to get insurance / ending job lock）。

part_b_training.title: 英语二新题型（小标题对应）全真模拟演练
part_b_training.instruction: 阅读 Text 4 的七个段落，从 A-G 七个候选项中为指定五个段落选出最精准概括段落主旨的小标题（含 2 个干扰项）：

options.heading: Survey Methodology Verifies Worker Autonomy and Subjective Choice
options.trap_analysis: 【🎯正确选项】准确提炼第5段：详述劳工调查方法学，证实受访者主动表达意愿是精准区分兼职性质的坚实证据。

options.heading: Immediate Repeal of All Healthcare Entitlements by Executive Order
options.trap_analysis: 【❌干扰陷阱：反向颠倒/无中生有】文章通篇为奥巴马医改赋能劳动者辩护，绝非取消医保福利。

options.heading: Headline Job Creation Figures Spark Mainstream Jubilation
options.trap_analysis: 【🎯正确选项】精准对应第1段：单月新增28.8万非农就业岗位与失业率骤降激起主流舆论的热烈庆祝。

options.heading: Complete Collapse of American Manufacturing Employment
options.trap_analysis: 【❌干扰陷阱：夸大曲解】文中未涉及美国制造业崩盘。

options.heading: The Overlooked Dimension: Structural Shifts in Part-Time Labor
options.trap_analysis: 【🎯正确选项】精准归纳第2段：在宏大头条数据掩盖下，兼职劳动力维度的关键异动长期被主流分析所忽视。

options.heading: Untethering Healthcare from Employment Shatters the 'Job Lock' Cage
options.trap_analysis: 【🎯正确选项】高度概括第7段结语：奥巴马医改让1200万人享有独立医保，打破工位锁定枷锁，赋能自愿灵活择业。

options.heading: Drawing a Crucial Line Between Voluntary and Involuntary Part-Time
options.trap_analysis: 【🎯正确选项】准确概括第3段：严密厘清自愿兼职与非自愿打零工之间的本质法律与经济分野。

part_b_training.skills_breakdown: 【小标题答题要诀】：段1抓亮眼头条数据（288,000 jobs headline）；段2抓被忽视的兼职板块（largely overlooked / part-time workers）；段3抓自愿与非自愿本质分野（distinction between voluntary and involuntary）；段5抓调查方法实证个体自主（methodology / people tell surveyors）；段7抓医保解绑打破工位锁定（insurance through ACA / ending job lock）。

writing_corpus.expression: look beyond the dazzling headline statistics to dissect the nuanced micro-dynamics of ...
writing_corpus.syntactic_type: 深度分析型动宾短语搭配
writing_corpus.translation: 跳出表面光鲜炫目的头条宏观数据，深入解构……极其微妙的微观动态
writing_corpus.application_sentence: Discerning economic analysts must look beyond the dazzling headline statistics to dissect the nuanced micro-dynamics of labor market participation.
writing_corpus.sentence_cn: 具备洞察力的经济学家与政策研究者必须学会跳出浮于表面、光鲜炫目的头条宏观数字，深入细致地解构劳动力市场参与率背后极其微妙的微观结构性动态变化。
writing_corpus.template_slot: Researchers must look beyond the dazzling headline statistics to dissect the nuanced micro-dynamics of [某复杂领域].

writing_corpus.expression: emanate not from economic despair, but from the deliberate untethering of ... from ...
writing_corpus.syntactic_type: not from...but from解放性因果句式
writing_corpus.translation: 绝非源于经济绝望与被迫萧条，而恰恰源于将……与……进行深思熟虑的彻底松绑与解钩
writing_corpus.application_sentence: The rise in flexible working hours emanates not from economic despair, but from the deliberate untethering of essential healthcare from rigid corporate employment.
writing_corpus.sentence_cn: 灵活弹性工作时长的自发普及激增，绝非源于经济萧条导致的走投无路与生存绝望，而恰恰源于国家福利立法将至关重要的人生看病医保与严苛僵化的传统企业雇佣关系的彻底松绑与制度性脱钩。
writing_corpus.template_slot: This progressive shift emanates not from economic despair, but from the deliberate untethering of [生命基本保障] from [严苛人身依附].

writing_corpus.expression: A critical distinction must be drawn between involuntary hardship and the empowered exercise of ...
writing_corpus.syntactic_type: 被动语态概念界定论述句
writing_corpus.translation: 在迫于无奈的非自愿痛苦挣扎与充满自主权的行使……之间，必须划定极其鲜明分明的原则界限
writing_corpus.application_sentence: A critical distinction must be drawn between involuntary employment hardship and the empowered exercise of personal autonomy in balancing family life.
writing_corpus.sentence_cn: 在迫于生计走投无路的非自愿失业阵痛与充分行使个体自主权以从容平衡家庭生活之间，必须划定一道极其严密且泾渭分明的原则界限。
writing_corpus.template_slot: A critical distinction must be drawn between involuntary [生存困境] and the empowered exercise of [自由自主选择权].

writing_corpus.expression: Were public policy to dismantle the archaic shackles of 'job lock', millions of capable citizens would be liberated to ...
writing_corpus.syntactic_type: 虚拟语气条件句倒装结构
writing_corpus.translation: 倘若公共政策能够彻底砸碎'工位锁定'的陈旧枷锁，数以百万计的健全公民就将彻底获得解放，从而能够自由地去……
writing_corpus.application_sentence: Were public policy to dismantle the archaic shackles of 'job lock', millions of capable citizens would be liberated to pursue entrepreneurial ventures and caregiving.
writing_corpus.sentence_cn: 倘若国家的公共保障政策能够果断砸碎'唯有固定死守工位才能换取基本医保'的陈腐制度枷锁，数以千万计具有拼搏才干的公民就将彻底获得解放，从而能够自由无拘地投身自主创业与照料家庭。
writing_corpus.template_slot: Were the state to dismantle the archaic shackles of [制度桎梏], millions of citizens would be liberated to [自由施展才华/追求幸福].

writing_corpus.expression: decouple basic human welfare from traditional employment models to unleash individual dynamism and social resilience
writing_corpus.syntactic_type: 制度松绑前瞻动宾倡议搭配
writing_corpus.translation: 将国民基础民生福祉与陈旧的传统雇佣模式全面解耦脱钩，以此释放蓬勃的个体活力与强大的社会综合韧性
writing_corpus.application_sentence: Progressive welfare architectures must decouple basic healthcare and pensions from traditional full-time employment to unleash creative dynamism across society.
writing_corpus.sentence_cn: 具有前瞻性的现代社会保障体系必须坚决推动基础医疗与养老等兜底福祉与过时的传统全职雇佣模式全面解耦脱钩，从而在全社会范围内彻底释放生机勃勃的个体创造活力与强大韧性。
writing_corpus.template_slot: Modern legislation must decouple basic welfare protections from [僵化旧模式] to unleash individual dynamism and social resilience.
